description:
Prepare a cost-aware design-agent brief before editing UI.

Returns on success: JSON with mission, evidenceCommands, designRules, costControls, compatibility installs, MCP command, Agent Skills command, and handoffChecklist.

Use this tool: as the first MCP call when a coding agent is asked to design, polish, audit, refactor, or generate interface code. It is local-first and does not call Figma, browsers, or models.

agent.description: Agent stack to prioritize in compatibility guidance, such as codex, hermes, openclaw, cursor, or claude-code.

detail.description: Payload detail: compact for token-sensitive first turns, standard for runnable guidance, full for complete context.

intent.description: Natural language product/design task to optimize the brief around.

mode.description: Evidence mode: local, figma, research, or full.

target.description: Local path or URL the agent should inspect. Defaults to '.'.

name: prepare_design_agent_brief
